mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate reduces the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows, increasing present value and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. This signal is active during monetary easing cycles.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month average.

mechanism_narrative: A falling unemployment rate below 5.0% indicates a tightening labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts and retail sales signals strong consumer demand, leading to higher corporate revenues and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 100) signals an economic slowdown, prompting equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 2.5% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL) signals potential monetary tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL y/y > 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer confidence and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to predict positive returns in more than 40% of cases over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth (GDPC1 annualized growth > 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, leading to higher corporate profits and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS down > 0.25% in one month) signals imminent monetary easing, reducing borrowing costs and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25% in the past month.
